repos.name: humanlayer/humanlayer
repos.description: The best way to get AI coding agents to solve hard problems in complex codebases.
repos.one_liner: A developer-focused platform that integrates human-in-the-loop oversight into AI agent workflows.
bullets: Built with TypeScript to provide seamless integration for AI coding agents.
Enables real-time human approval and intervention for sensitive agentic operations.
Designed to solve complex, high-stakes coding tasks by bridging the gap between autonomous agents and human oversight.
Ideal for enterprise environments requiring audit trails and safety guardrails for AI-driven development.

repos.name: harvard-edge/cs249r_book
repos.description: Machine Learning Systems: Foundations, Scaling, Agentic AI, and Physical AI (Vols I–IV) • Harvard CS249r | https://mlsysbook.ai
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive, open-source academic resource covering the foundations of Machine Learning Systems and Agentic AI.
bullets: Python-based educational content covering ML systems, scaling, and physical AI.
Provides deep technical insights into the infrastructure required to support modern LLM and agentic workloads.
Serves as a foundational text for engineers building high-performance AI infrastructure.
Covers critical topics like distributed training, inference optimization, and agentic system architecture.

repos.name: anthropics/sandbox-runtime
repos.description: A lightweight sandboxing tool for enforcing filesystem and network restrictions on arbitrary processes at the OS level, without requiring a container.
repos.one_liner: A lightweight, container-free sandboxing tool for enforcing strict filesystem and network security policies.
bullets: Implemented in TypeScript to provide OS-level process isolation without the overhead of Docker or VMs.
Enforces granular security restrictions on arbitrary processes to prevent unauthorized system access.
Critical infrastructure component for safely executing untrusted code or AI agent tasks.
Reduces attack surface by limiting process capabilities at the kernel/OS interface.

repos.name: makecindy/cindy
repos.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
repos.one_liner: An open-source, out-of-the-box AI agent designed to execute complex tasks autonomously.
bullets: TypeScript-based architecture optimized for immediate deployment and task execution.
Focuses on agentic workflows that translate high-level intent into actionable, multi-step processes.
Designed to function as a general-purpose assistant for automating repetitive technical or administrative workflows.
Provides a modular framework for developers to extend agent capabilities for specific business domains.

repos.name: xevrion/hatchzip
repos.description: Extract huge archives in place: the archive shrinks as your files hatch, so you only need room for the output. ZIP, 7z, tar, split archives.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance Rust utility for extracting massive archives in-place to minimize disk space requirements.
bullets: Written in Rust for memory safety and high-throughput I/O performance.
Implements an in-place extraction algorithm that shrinks the source archive as files are processed.
Essential devtool for managing large datasets, logs, or model weights in resource-constrained environments.
Supports multiple formats including ZIP, 7z, and tar, making it a versatile utility for data-heavy infrastructure pipelines.
